lines: Fake products might not be perfect, but sometimes they offer surprising advantages over the real thing.
The biggest advantage is price. You can often get a similar look and basic function, without spending nearly as much.
Fake products can also give you access to styles and designs that might otherwise be too expensive, or difficult to find.
For some everyday items, the cheaper alternative may do the job well enough, especially when premium features aren't important.
Of course, quality and safety still matter. But when the risks are low, and the price difference is huge, fake can sometimes make more sense.
